title: Volvo Expands Nvidia Partnership for Automated Driving
excerpt: Volvo is broadening its long-standing collaboration with Nvidia to enhance its automated driving systems across more vehicle types.
body_html:
Volvo is deepening its collaboration with Nvidia to upgrade its automated driving technology. The expansion builds on a partnership that has lasted for nearly ten years.

Under the updated agreement, the automated driving system enhancements will extend beyond battery electric vehicles. The move marks a larger commitment by the automaker to utilize Nvidia's technology for its driving systems.
